privacy.justice_data_output: metadata and total overlap count only; no row-level or occupation-specific justice outcome
privacy.suppression_rule: No sensitive subgroup outcome counts were produced. Any later sensitive subgroup table must suppress n<5 at minimum and follow then-current BLS/source requirements.

limitations: Round-6 Goldberg items were administered only to respondents age <=14 at the end of 1996, so that sample is not the full cohort.
TIPI is very brief and does not cover the 240-model-trait vocabulary.
Some 2018 SOC role mappings collapse into broader 2002 Census categories; translation quality is explicit row by row.
Weighted estimates are descriptive; no standard errors or inferential tests were computed.
